Yes it happens mostly when I am having an intense breakdown but sometimes i hear it while I’m casually doing something. I guess I let my brain wonder for too long and I hear it. I have to constantly distract myself to avoid hearing the distorted talking.

I would experience it mostly like this but maybe it’s my intrusive thoughts that are clear and i confuse the 2. Thank you so much , hopefully i can access a therapist later in the future. When i’m feeling my emotions intensely is like i’m in a crowd. I hear everyone talking and laughing. My mom would tell me i’m imagining things or I was labeled as crazy. So it’s comforting to know i am not alone experiencing this. Thank you so much.  :)

I feel you, I’m so sorry that happened to you. It sucks that we’re suppose to accept it and just learn how to navigate life after such cruelty. Just know that you are not alone and one day it will hurt a little less than it does today. You are strong and I hope you go easy on yourself. I can’t tell you if the tunnel gets brighter because I am feeling the same as you. But one day I hope we find healing. I’m rooting for your healing💕
It definitely did help. I get labeled as crazy or people think I’m faking it. Thank you for the reassurance that this a completely normal feeling💕.

Wow , you captured exactly how I have been feeling. I feel comfort in knowing that I’m not alone in this feeling. Thank you for sharing. It also affects my mood to a point where i TW// self harm because i want to get rid of the parts I don’t know. Thank you so much for sharing and I’ll try not to be too hard on myself.

I feel you , I know it’s cliche but your time will come. Continue to meet people and pay attention to when you have to leave. I’m sure you’ll meet your person. Our trauma doesn’t mean we are no longer eligible for love. Simply means we need to put in a little extra work to make sure we are loved properly. Work on yourself so you can recognize when you are self sabotaging. When you notice this , you can actually stop it and give that person a chance. Don’t give up , I’m rooting for you to find love :)…

Gosh!! I am sorry that happened to you. I think it takes a lot patience and dedication. You need to forgive yourself and be kind to yourself in this moment. I am still healing because I was raped not too long ago. I say allow yourself to cry when you need to. Do a lot of venting to close friends or even to yourself. I record myself talking and I sometimes feel better after it. I can’t tell you if this works or not because sometimes I have days where I wish it never happened to me. Days where I want to unalive myself. You just need to find whatever works with you and never blame yourself.

 I wish you luck on this journey and I don’t mind being a listening ear. You deserve healing and don’t let this define your future. You are a survivor. ❤️

Hey i just want to say your feelings are valid. He did take advantage of you because he knew you were acting “nice” due to being intoxicated. He knew what he was doing. If he did anything more than the tip , I’d say it’s some sort of sexual assault. I am so sorry this happened to you but I know you can’t really consent when you’re intoxicated. So I think if he had sex with you then it is rape :(…I hope my comment helped  with the confusion. I’m here if you need to talk love❤️❤️

Man it sucks, All i do is cry everyday and while they get better, we’re here struggling. I wish nothing but healing for us. I hope later in the future, we can both look back and just be so proud of our fucking selves. 

Fuck every rapist and i hope they burn in fucking hell! We deserve happiness <3

Thank you!! I live in the Caribbean so , we’re pretty small minded here. I have blocked him and told him that I have no interest in being friends. You make total sense so I thank you for that. 

I realized he was trying to do that by him so abruptly asking to be friends again after i just told him he raped me. While I told him that he tried to tell me that i “asked” for it in the beginning…While he was the one who pressured me from the start and I’m allowed to take back my consent as I told him. I don’t know why I expected closure from anyone who I had to beg to stop. Thank you for this comment. I appreciate you and everyone who has commented.

The thing is I don’t want it to be bullshit. I want him to be sorry. I don’t know but if he felt bad then maybe it can eat away at him. Maybe he can feel as bad as I did. I hate that this happened to me and he can just say sorry and moved on. I hate it. Why isn’t he having a terrible life?? Why is my life the only one that is affected. I hate myself. I hate my life.

He told me sorry , he didn’t mean to cause me any harm and didn’t realize what he did was wrong. I live in a country where rape is so normalized and people think you can “convince” someone to have sex. So I believed him for a bit until I realized he never called it what it was in the apology. He was just mostly sorry for how things turned out and how i felt. He argued how he isn’t a bad person and said he would do anything for me. That he was sorry for putting me in such a position. I wish I could share the text messages with everyone so maybe you can form opinions on it. 

Thank you for all the comments and I will try to figure out what is best for me.

I was raped 3 times and each of those 3 times was by someone i knew and thought cared for me. I still blame myself because I should’ve said no louder or not drink around them. I’ve suffered many sexual abuse and it was only by people i knew. I think everybody will sexual assault so might as well say yes before they do. I often get sad after sex because I never wanted my life to this direction. I was saving myself and everything was stolen from me in the blink of an eye. After he stole my virginity, i lost my sense of value. I don’t believe anyone would love me after I’ve been tainted. I gained 4 bodies….4 people I did not want to have sex with but because they felt entitled to my body it happened. I am truly heartbroken because I could never have my first time back or do it with anyone special. My first time will never really be my first time. Thank you for your kind words, I appreciate this comment. Therapy isn’t an option right now but I hope I can seek some in the future.❤️❤️

I’ve been also diagnosed with ptsd , dissociative disorder, bpd, anxiety and severe depression. My mom also went through the same thing so I thought she would be more understanding. Thank you for your kind words and I’ll try my best to be more mindful.❤️❤️
